verticals.name: Trades and building
verticals.note: Plumbers, electricians, HVAC, builders, any business that runs jobs out of ServiceM8, Simpro, Tradify, Fergus or similar.

verticals.name: Fire and electrical compliance
verticals.note: Asset registers, service cycles, defect quotes, compliance packs.

verticals.name: Accounting and bookkeeping
verticals.note: Practices and the businesses they keep books for: Xero, MYOB, receivables, payables, reporting.

verticals.name: Property and real estate
verticals.note: Property management and sales agencies: arrears, compliance, vendor reporting, open homes.

verticals.name: B2B office work
verticals.note: Back-office work any business-to-business firm shares: inbox, filing, follow-up, knowledge, exceptions. Consumer-facing bots do not qualify.

events.name: call.received
events.means: A call or voicemail landed. The only hop allowed to match on a phone number, because no job exists yet.

events.name: email.received
events.means: A message arrived in a watched inbox.

events.name: document.received
events.means: A file landed in a watched folder.

events.name: schedule.tick
events.means: A routine woke on its schedule. It lists records by status from the system of record, then works each one by its id.

events.name: job.created
events.means: The job system issued a job id.

events.name: job.updated
events.means: A field the mesh reads changed on the job.

events.name: job.completed
events.means: The job was marked complete in the job system.

events.name: quote.sent
events.means: A quote left the business, with the job id it was drafted from.

events.name: quote.accepted
events.means: The customer accepted the quote in the system of record.

events.name: quote.declined
events.means: The customer declined, or the quote expired.

events.name: invoice.raised
events.means: The ledger returned an invoice id. Draft or approved, it has an id that reads back.

events.name: invoice.sent
events.means: The invoice was sent from the ledger.

events.name: invoice.overdue
events.means: The invoice passed its due date unpaid, read off the live ledger.

events.name: promise.recorded
events.means: A dated promise to pay was written onto the invoice in the ledger.

events.name: payment.received
events.means: Money arrived and was applied in the ledger.

events.name: bill.received
events.means: A supplier bill was entered in the ledger.

events.name: rent.overdue
events.means: Rent on a tenancy fell into arrears in the property system.

events.name: asset.service_due
events.means: An asset in the register came due for its service or test.

events.name: report.published
events.means: A report was written into the system the reader opens.

events.name: exception.raised
events.means: A step stopped and named a person. Everything downstream of that record waits.

events.name: exception.closed
events.means: The named person closed the exception. The chain may resume from the record.
